root_cause_rules: Use the narrowest defensible code rather than a whole-domain label.
For analytical failures, inspect whether the learner first failed to identify information, distinguish categories, connect evidence or justify a conclusion.
For T3 writing, distinguish weak planning, weak idea generation, weak elaboration and weak language control.
For tersirat errors, verify explicit-information comprehension before diagnosing inference weakness.
For grammar analysis errors, inspect lower-level word-class, phrase and sentence-structure prerequisites.
Do not infer oral/audiovisual performance from a written upload alone.
OCR uncertainty is not learner error.
Cross-source and cross-date repetition raises diagnostic confidence.
